text:
Jin: Heads up — starting config-only deploy cfg-20260321-01 at 16:30 UTC. Changes: routing weight tweak, idle_timeout 1500->1000ms, tinybatch.max_tokens 64->48. Canary 10 nodes for 10m then 50% ramp. Deploy-bot will post updates. Please ack if you're watching.

deploy-bot: started canary for cfg-20260321-01 on service=inference-router env=prod nodes=10 canary_window=10m id=ddb-7890123456

Priya: Ack. I'll watch error rate and p95 latency. Can we pin model version for the canary? Last time we saw KV cache pressure with mixed variants.

Jin: @Priya good call — pinning model:v3.2 for canary only.

Mateo: Seeing a small rise in CPU on canary hosts, +4% and +4ms p50. Could be infra noise. Holding ramp until we get 5m of stable telemetry.

deploy-bot: canary 5m metrics: error_rate=0.12% p50=88ms (+4ms) p95=310ms (+12ms) kv_cache_hits=98.1%

Ben: Those numbers look acceptable. Tinybatch change may bump p50 slightly; should reduce tail. If CPU keeps rising we can lower concurrency.

Kelly: ODS dashboard: https://ods/redwood/boards/789 — I added an annotation at canary start. Also saw two infra kernel upgrades on node-a-12 at 16:32; could be noisy neighbor.

Priya: Given infra noise, prefer pausing the ramp. Also request top-10 tenants be excluded from any broader rollout until we confirm stability. Please add tenant-exclude list.

Jin: Pausing ramp. I'll update the rollout plan and release-note snippet. Proposed action: rollback tinybatch change globally, keep idle_timeout tweak if stable.

Zoe: From product POV the timeout reduction helps UX — let's keep that if safe. Update release notes: 'Idle timeout reduced to improve interactive sessions; batching tuning reverted for broad rollout.'

Jin: Config diff (canary):
```
- tinybatch.max_tokens: 64
+ tinybatch.max_tokens: 48
- idle_timeout_ms: 1500
+ idle_timeout_ms: 1000
```
We'll revert the tinybatch change in prod and keep the timeout if error rate stays low.

deploy-bot: halted ramp at 10 nodes per request from Jin. queued action: partial_rollback tinybatch to previous for all except canary. action_id=act-7890123456

deploy-bot: partial_rollback applied: tinybatch.max_tokens -> 64 globally except nodes tagged canary. action complete.

Mateo: Confirming global tinybatch is back to 64. Canaries still on 48 for now.

Priya: Observability: error_rate now 0.10% and p50 back to baseline. Will monitor for 30m. If stable we can plan a targeted re-rollout in a low-traffic window.

Jin: Thanks all. I'll update release notes and add rollback rationale to the changelog. After 30m stable we'll either re-run with a different concurrency cap or schedule for midnight UTC quiet window. :thumbsup:

Kelly: Adding a post-deploy note and flagging kernel-upgrade correlation. Ticket: https://ods/redwood/tickets/INC-1011
